clause_ii.reason: For each fixed static state, the current screenshot plus the prior action history is sufficient to identify the visible pane arrangement, contour correspondence, transforms, unlocked fragment/aperture geometry, and the applicable direct or proxy control. clause_iii.reason: No legitimate D has an action whose value strictly decreases during a no-action delay. CSS footfall/glow is cosmetic.
